description: Frozen contract fixture shared by MidMem (roadmap #49 library lane) and every library system that serves it (first: U4CSolutions/kb-article-library). MidMem tests fuse these responses from a fake provider; a library tests that its real provider returns this SHAPE and these top documents for these queries. Chunk boundaries are the fake provider's data, not a chunking rule.

transports: in-process ES module exporting { search, get }
HTTP: POST <base>/provider/search, POST <base>/provider/get, JSON bodies below
rules: search never returns a chunk from a library other than filters.libraryId when that filter is set
results are ordered by score descending; ties broken by docId then chunkId ascending
get(docId, locator) returns exactly the text between charStart and charEnd of that document version
an unknown docId or a locator outside the document is an error, never empty text
the provider is read-only: no request mutates the library

documents.text: The osprey relay batches outbound writes and flushes them every ninety seconds. When the relay loses its upstream link it keeps a bounded queue on disk and replays it in order once the link returns. Operators tune the flush interval with the relay.flush setting.

The heron scheduler pins worker processes to cores and rotates the pinning every hour. Version two added a drain mode so a pinned worker finishes its current job before rotation. Drain mode is enabled with heron --drain.
The tern cache keeps recently read pages in memory and evicts the least recently used page when the cache is full. A page that is read again within an hour is kept regardless of its age.
